studio.name: DIO Proof-Led Services
studio.tagline: Inspect the work before you trust the promise.
studio.domain: proof-led workflow services for South African educators researchers NGOs and evidence teams
studio.description: Commercial stories built from real DIO artefacts, explicit human approval and bounded pilot offers.

audience.knowledge_level: working professional evaluating a service provider
viewer_jobs: show me a real before-and-after case
explain what I submit and receive
audience.vocabulary: plain professional language grounded in assessments evidence review and delivery

personas.name: Education Workload Owner
personas.description: An educator, lecturer or academic manager responsible for assessment quality and turnaround.
personas.desired_reward: A bounded pilot whose finished artefact can be inspected before adoption.
personas.likely_next_action: Review a sample pack or nominate one assessment brief.

personas.name: Evidence Accountability Owner
personas.description: An NGO, research or programme professional who must turn scattered records into defensible evidence.
personas.desired_reward: A review-ready evidence pack with traceable claims and a visible approval boundary.
personas.likely_next_action: Inspect the golden case or nominate one bounded evidence period.

promise.statement: Every offer is demonstrated with a real artefact, a visible workflow, an explicit human approval boundary and a bounded next step.
required: open with the finished proof artefact
use one attributable call to action
separate demonstrated capability from future claims
prohibited: generic AI imagery replacing product proof

topic_examples: show a CAPS-aligned assessment pack from brief to educator approval
turn scattered NGO reporting records into a provenance-backed evidence pack
compare messy assessment inputs with a review-ready exam and memorandum
demonstrate claim mapping and human approval in an evidence workflow
run a bounded proof-led pilot without replacing professional judgement

disallowed_sources: private prospect records in public creative
research.conflict_policy: Prefer inspected product artefacts and authoritative source documents; label demonstrations estimates and hypotheses separately.

archetypes.name: Proof Case
archetypes.description: Move from recognisable workload through real artefact, workflow, approval and bounded pilot.

archetypes.name: Workflow Walkthrough
archetypes.description: Show what enters the service, what the system does, what the professional reviews and what is delivered.

archetypes.name: Proof Comparison
archetypes.description: Compare an unmanaged starting state with the reviewed product artefact using declared criteria.

motion_rules: hold proof long enough to inspect
use movement to reveal workflow state
keep source text and labels readable
show approval as a deliberate action

voice.tone: direct, proof-led, professionally confident and candid about boundaries
voice.pacing: fast at the pain point, deliberate while inspecting proof, concise at the call to action

compliance.synthetic_reconstruction_disclosure: required whenever a generated scene could be mistaken for a real client case

trust_rules: sales permission is independent of market priority

promise_tests: Can a viewer inspect real work?
Is the professional approval boundary unmistakable?
Is the next action bounded and attributable?

samples.working_title: Inspect a CAPS assessment pack before commissioning one
samples.topic: CAPS-aligned assessment pack with educator approval
samples.story_premise: Show the finished paper memo and validation receipt before the workflow.

samples.working_title: From scattered records to a review-ready evidence pack
samples.topic: evidence pack claim mapping and provenance
samples.story_premise: Open with the golden case and trace one claim back to its source.
